7. For U7 and U8, reuse Spring Security's ACL module for access control to DSL Shell and Admin UI resources, mapping existing Spring XD resource operations (create stream, destroy stream, view streams) to ACL permissions for consistency.
8. All new modules (Python processor, R processor, Hive sink) will follow Spring XD's existing module structure and configuration patterns to ensure consistency with existing user experience.
